raw_posts.name: HireKey
raw_posts.tagline: Your recruiter-informed AI copilot for tech job search
raw_posts.description: HireKey is a recruiter-informed AI job-search co-pilot for tech job seekers who want to apply strategically & interview with confidence. It helps you assess your role fit, tailor resumes, communicate experience & track applications. Unlike basic ATS tools, HireKey combines AI with 10 years of recruiting experience at Microsoft, Amazon & Stripe, plus practice out loud with an interactive AI voice coach that responds to your answers & provides real-time interview feedback.

raw_posts.name: kōdlo
raw_posts.tagline: End-to-end sales workspace with unified context
raw_posts.description: kōdlo finds prospects that fit your ICP and tells you how to warm each one up. Upload product catalogues and other docs to the Knowledge Hub, and its agent turns them into personalized messages, offers, deep searches and decks. Track client data, collaborate with your team, and manage tasks, all in one place. Connect Claude Desktop/ChatGPT Work or your code agent with kōdlo MCP to scale and orchestrate contexts.

raw_posts.name: Automations in Perplexity Computer
raw_posts.tagline: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
raw_posts.description: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

raw_posts.name: Ghost Core
raw_posts.tagline: A personal AI computer that runs entirely on-device
raw_posts.description: Ghost Core is a personal AI computer that runs AI models on-device, connects to your apps, files, and devices, and builds continuous context to proactively help you.

raw_posts.name: OpenScreen 2
raw_posts.tagline: Record your demo and let your AI agent do the edits
raw_posts.description: Record your screen and the demo looks great on the first take: zooms planned from your clicks, smooth cursor, 3D camera moves, cursor themes, backgrounds and webcam layouts. Then let your AI agent do the edit over MCP, or cut the video yourself by deleting words in the transcript. Windows, macOS and Linux. Free, MIT, no account, no watermark.

raw_posts.name: MePersona
raw_posts.tagline: Answer every fan comment in your voice
raw_posts.description: MePersona is the unified social media inbox for content creators, but the inbox is only where it starts. Your Persona learns how you talk and improves with every reply you approve. It drafts replies to comments and DMs from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and more, scores how much each sounds like you, and remembers what each fan said last time. Nothing posts until you hit Send. It works in English and Spanish, so bilingual creators stop choosing which half of their audience gets a real answer.

raw_posts.name: Ayven
raw_posts.tagline: Carries and drives your team's agenda
raw_posts.description: Ayven drives your agenda. It means observing, cutting the work into pieces your team can take one at a time, putting an owner and a date on each, and filing them in Jira or YouTrack. Then it runs, tracks and talks about the work for weeks: asking whoever knows, waiting, chasing silence, moving work when someone is away. Your team answers in Slack and the board moves. Planning stops being the barrier and you ship your agenda like crazy.

raw_posts.name: FocusWrite
raw_posts.tagline: A local-first writing app with focus modes.
raw_posts.description: A calm, local-first writing app with deep focus, ambient sounds, optional cloud sync, and PDF export.

raw_posts.name: Foley
raw_posts.tagline: A voice to-do list that files, plans and asks first
raw_posts.description: Say what needs doing. Foley turns it into a task with the project, date and reminder already set, and asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your list. Capture from your Apple Watch. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro runs the AI for you and syncs every device. On iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web.

raw_posts.name: Gboard Kurukuru Version
raw_posts.tagline: Your fingers stay put. The keys come around
raw_posts.description: Gboard Kurukuru Version is a conveyor belt keyboard from Google Japan's Gboard team, its 15th. Four belts carry 29 keys each past your fingers, so one hand can reach every character. It isn't for sale, but STL files, firmware and a build guide are on GitHub.
